meta.note: Rule from published research (Gao, Han, Li & Zhou, 2018), applied unchanged: the move from yesterday's close to 10:00 sets the direction for a 3:30 → 4:00 trade. Every year shown is after the paper's own data, so this is an out-of-sample test. 3x ETFs, $100 per trade, $0.005 per share each way. Compare with Random control, which makes the same trade with a coin flip for direction

groups.name: Intraday momentum
groups.desc: Morning move (yesterday's close → 10:00) sets the direction · buy at 3:30, sell at 4:00

models.rule: Trade if the 10:00 move is at least 0.50% · hold 3:30 → 4:00

groups.desc: Same 3:30 → 4:00 trade, coin flip for direction · the yardstick to beat
